It does not require root, Xposed, or Shizuku. Accessibility Service is only needed when text mode is enabled. How to use Statusbarplus 1. Turn on “Show day”.

2. For real text in the status bar without bitmap rendering, open “Status bar text mode” and enable Statusbarplus in Accessibility settings. This uses an Accessibility Overlay and does not require root, Xposed, or Shizuku.

3. Choose the status-bar content, font, and text size. Two-line modes are automatically capped to avoid clipping.

4. If text mode is not enabled, the app uses notification fallback and needs notification permission.

5. If your device often stops background apps, allow the battery-optimization exemption. This is optional.
